item.content:encoded: This is amazing, and I’m gonna try keep this brief because I’m absolutely in love with how this is written, but the way that you’ve meshed the abject horror of drowning with some incredible characterisation of Able is just fantastic. 10/10, wish I could upvote more than once.

This is written absolutely fantastically and manages to do interesting things with a character that has already been used quite excessively. The title is also quite clever. Simply brilliant work.

A definite +1

item.content:encoded: This tale draws a bit of inspiration from "Through the Tunnel" by Doris Lessing, a wonderful short story that mildly traumatized me when I had to read it in sixth grade. I am extremely grateful to everyone who gave me their feedback on the forums.
